payload.title: FVG_CONT selector=8 MT5 isolation diagnostic (recipe R, no promotion)
payload.question: Under ResearchMode isolation (selector=8, GOLD H4, fixed lot 0.01, harness Phase 7.23), what is the closed-trade sample size and mean recipe R of canonical FVG_CONT on 2023.10.02–2026.06.30, and is the sample large enough (n>=30) for a later edge prereg vs habitat controls — without promoting from Python/sweep37 PF?

A_ISOLATION_RECIPE.definition: All closed LIQ-attributed? No — all closed trades with strategy==FVG_CONT from the isolation run CSV (recipe R from EA log).

B_DENSITY_CHECK.definition: n_closed and trades/month vs LIQ_SWEEP diagnostic baseline (~42 in same window).

payload.primary_comparison: descriptive: n and mean_R of arm A; no B−C habitat test in this phase
payload.primary_outcome: n_closed_FVG_CONT and mean recipe R (gross from trades CSV)
secondary_outcomes: month_block CI95 on mean R if n>=5 and >=3 months

decision_rule_frozen.SAMPLE_READY_FOR_EDGE_PREREG: n_closed >= 30 AND certificate/trades reconciliation OK — still NOT an edge claim; unlocks a SEPARATE habitat/regime prereg only
decision_rule_frozen.HARNESS_OR_IDENTITY_PROBLEM: reconciliation fail, unexpected stratNames other than FVG_CONT in CSV, or OPENED=0 with non-empty unexpected side effects

data_policy.window_note: Same calendar span as LIQ_SWEEP Phase 7.23 diagnostic for density comparison. This window is EXPOSED for LIQ_SWEEP economics; for FVG_CONT it is first dedicated isolation under this hypothesis_id — label DISCOVERY if any prior FVG_CONT look is found, else DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST_LOOK. Not a sealed holdout.
forbidden: Promoting FVG_CONT to SUPPORTED from this run
Using Python/sweep37 PF as primary outcome

payload.power_note: Phase 7.30 showed ~3-week forward can yield n=0. This diagnostic uses ~2.7y H4 to estimate density before any confirmatory prereg. SAMPLE_READY_FOR_EDGE_PREREG ≠ SIGNAL_SUPPORTED.
explicit_non_goals: No FVG_MIT_WINDOW CTF fix in this phase
